headline: Expanse Battle Deepens as Mooring, Nevish Lines Shift
war_summary: Since the morning edition the fighting has thickened in the Weathered Expanse with twelve changes in two hours and sixty-three on the day about Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, holdings now four Warden, two Colonial and three unheld with day losses of 8,208 Colonial and 11,145 Warden; Mooring County has moved to ten Warden to two Colonial with six changes in two hours and thirty-four on the day centred on Gravekeeper's Holdfast, day losses 7,103 Colonial and 6,165 Warden. Callahan's Passage remains wholly Warden with three changes in two hours and nineteen on the day about Crumbling Post, while the Nevish Line stands six Warden to two Colonial, quiet in the last two hours after three in six and twenty-four on the day about Blackcoat Way. Palantine Berm, still seven Warden, has gone quiet in the last six hours after nine changes on the day, and Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row record no changes in the last six hours after eighteen and fifteen changes respectively on the day.
